<item>
	<title><![CDATA[Railway PSU stocks derailed! RVNL, IRFC, IRCON, RITES to IRCTC down 40% in yr- What went wrong? Experts explain]]></title>
	
	<link><![CDATA[https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/railway-psu-stocks-derailed-rvnl-irfc-ircon-rites-to-irctc-down-60-in-yr-what-went-wrong-experts-explain-11792225685815.html]]></link>
	
	<description><![CDATA[Railway PSU stocks have fallen sharply after valuations outpaced fundamentals. Experts cite slowing growth, squeezed margins and weak order conversion—not a lack of railway spending—as key concerns, despite a record FY27 capital outlay of  ₹2.93 lakh crore.]]></description>

<item>
	<title><![CDATA[HDFC Bank Q2 Results: Net profit rises 5% to  ₹19,510 crore, NII jumps 10% in last quarter under outgoing CEO Jagdishan]]></title>
	
	<link><![CDATA[https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/hdfc-bank-q2-results-net-profit-rises-5-to-rs-19-610-crore-nii-jumps-10-in-last-quarter-under-outgoing-ceo-jagdishan-11792226165605.html]]></link>
	
	<description><![CDATA[HDFC Bank reported an around 5% year-on-year rise in standalone net profit to  ₹19,509.96 crore in Q2 FY27. Net interest income increased 9.72% to  ₹34,619.18 crore, while gross and net bad-loan ratios stood at 1.11% and 0.37%, respectively.]]></description>
	
	<pubDate><![CDATA[Sat, 17 Oct 2026 14:16:54 +0530]]></pubDate>

	<title><![CDATA[Axis Bank Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 38% YoY- Check asset quality, stock trend, and other key highlights]]></title>
	
	<link><![CDATA[https://www.livemint.com/market/commodities/axis-bank-q2-results-net-profit-jumps-38-yoy-check-asset-quality-stock-trend-and-other-key-highlights-11792223868805.html]]></link>
	
	<description><![CDATA[Axis Bank reported a 38% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to  ₹7,003 crore. Net interest income increased 12% to  ₹15,371 crore, while net interest margin was 3.36%. Gross and net NPA ratios fell to 1.16% and 0.35%, respectively.]]></description>

<item>
	<title><![CDATA[Paytm shares rally 50% in 6 months, but Nomura sees 33% more upside, initiates with 'buy'; check target price, rationale]]></title>
	
	<link><![CDATA[https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/paytm-shares-rally-50-in-6-months-but-nomura-sees-33-more-upside-initiates-with-buy-check-target-price-rationale-11792215152382.html]]></link>
	
	<description><![CDATA[Nomura initiated coverage of Paytm with a Buy rating and a  ₹2,250 target, implying 33% upside. It expects rapid earnings growth, driven by digital payments, merchant lending, cost efficiencies and new revenue streams. Key risks include competition and deteriorating lending asset quality.]]></description>
	
	<pubDate><![CDATA[Sat, 17 Oct 2026 12:05:15 +0530]]></pubDate>
